name: 可视化模板图库
description: Browse every template of a local Skill in a read-only web page and copy template names back into the conversation.
description_zh: 用本地只读网页浏览任意模板 Skill 的全部模板，勾选后复制模板名称带回对话，辅助生图与设计任务。
description_en: Browse all templates of any local Skill in a read-only web page, select templates and copy their names back into the conversation to guide image and design tasks.
examples_zh: 打开 gpt-image-2-style-library 的模板图库
浏览我本地有哪些可用的设计模板
列出这个 Skill 的全部模板让我挑一个
examples_en: Open the template gallery of gpt-image-2-style-library
Browse what design templates I have locally
List all templates of this Skill so I can pick one
